visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair and glasses is speaking into a large professional microphone. She is wearing a grey sparkling cardigan over a white button-down shirt. The background is a dark grey curtain. (2) 3D animation of microscopic mites crawling on skin surface near hair follicles. The skin is pinkish-red with several hair shafts protruding. (3) The woman is shown again in a medium shot, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. The lighting is soft and focused on her. (4) Split-screen comparison of a patient's face before and after treatment, showing significant reduction in redness and acne scars. (5) Close-up photos of inflamed skin with red bumps and enlarged pores on a person's nose and cheeks. (6) Microscopic footage shows a tiny, long-bodied mite moving on a textured pink surface. (7) The woman continues speaking, looking slightly off-camera. She raises her index finger to emphasize a point. (8) A white screen appears with the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo, contact information including Line ID, phone number, and two addresses in Traditional Chinese.

(2) As she discusses Demodex mites in hair follicles, her tone remains informative. A subtle 'pop' sound effect occurs as text overlays appear on screen. The music remains at a constant low volume bed. (3) She lists various skin conditions (darkness, texture) associated with mites. Her speech rate is natural and engaging. The BGM maintains its rhythmic drive. (4) The speaker emphasizes the importance of clinical diagnosis. A slight shift in vocal intensity conveys authority. Small bell-like SFX punctuate the transition between points. (5) The video concludes with the speaker summarizing the treatment path. The BGM fades slightly at the very end as she mentions the clinic, leading into the final brand slide.
